title: (Deprecated) Create Collection ads
content_data:
Collection ads are a type of in-feed video ad on TikTok that leads your customers to an instant storefront page, where they can shop for your products without ever leaving the app. > **Note**
Starting from Feb.16,2023, you can no longer create Collection Ads. To ensure a smooth API integration, we recommend you migrate to [Video Shopping Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1741942291730434&rid=tv5sdeafqp) under Product Sales objective. The modification of existing Collection Ads through API will be supported till the end of March, and may be extended on a case-by-case basis. If you need extra transition time, please contact your TikTok representatives. Collection ads allow retailers to show off their inspirational branded video with a few key product tiles at the bottom that lead to a quick-load storefront. This makes for an engaging browsing and shopping experience. > **Note**
Collection Ads is currently in Beta. If you would like access to this feature, please contact your TikTok representative to apply for allowlisting. Creating a collection ad involves the following steps: 1. Set up your product catalog. You need to create a product catalog and upload products to your product catalog. 2. Create and configure a storefront page. 3. Create a collection ad. # 1. Set up the product catalog **Note**: Catalog, Products, and Product Sets are allowlist-only features. If you are already on the allowlist for Collection Ads, these features will be enabled for you automatically. ## 1.1 Create a product catalog Use the [/catalog/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740306481704961) endpoint to create a product catalog. Specify the name, targeting country, and currency in the request. Here is an example of the data part in the request. ``` xcodeblock (code JSON json) { "bc_id": 123, "name": "my_catalog", "catalog_type": "ECOM", "catalog_conf": { "region_code": "US", "currency": "USD", "channel": "CLIENT" } } (/code) ``` ## 1.2 Upload products to the product catalog Use the [/catalog/product/file/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740496787164161) or [/catalog/product/upload/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740497429681153) endpoints to add your products to the product catalog. The example below uses the [/catalog/product/upload/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740497429681153) endpoint. ``` xcodeblock (code JSON json) { "bc_id": 123, "catalog_id": 456, "dpa_products": [ { "sku_id": "tiktok_item_1111", "title": "qgs test product1", "description": "qgs test product description", "availability": "AVAILABLE_FOR_ORDER", "image_link": "http://p1.ipstatp.com/origin/ad-site-i18n/xxxxxxx", "video_link": "https://www.tiktok.com/tiktok_t_shirt", "brand": "xiaoru", "additional_image_link": ["xxxxxxx", "http://p1.ipstatp.com/origin/ad-site-i18n/xxxxxxx"], "item_group_id": "1.11", "google_product_category": "2.22", "gtin": "3.33", "mpn": "4.44", "landing_url": { "link": "https://www.tiktok.com", "android_url": "https://www.android.com", "android_package": "a.b.com", "android_app_name": "android_app_name", "ios_url": "https://www.ios.com", "ios_app_store_id": "https://ios_app_store.com", "ios_app_name": "ios_app_name", "ipad_url": "https://ipad.com", "ipad_app_store_id": "https://ipad_app_store.com", "ipad_app_name": "ipad_app_name", "iphone_url": "https://iphone.com", "iphone_app_store_id": "https://iphone_app_store.com", "iphone_app_name": "iphone_app_name" }, "price": { "price": "100", "sale_price": 30, "currency": "USD", "sale_price_effective_date": "2021-10-01T0:00/2021-10-31T0:00" }, "profession": { "condition": "USED", "age_group": "NEW_BORN", "color": "red", "gender": "MALE", "shipping": "US:CA:Ground:9.99 USD", "shipping_weight": "1 kg", "size": "L", "tax": "xxx", "material": "cotton", "pattern": "stripes1", "product_type": "Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Shirts" }, "ext": { "custom_label_0": "a", "custom_label_1": "b", "custom_label_2": "c", "custom_label_3": "d", "custom_label_4": "e" } } ] } (/code) ``` # 2. Create a storefront page ## 2.1 Create and configure a storefront page Create a storefront page. A storefront page is a template for collection ads that can showcase multiple products in one place. ## 2.2 Get the page ID Use the [/page/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737719918220290) endpoint to get the page_id of the storefront page. **Note** 1. Please set `business_type` to `STORE_FRONT`. 2. Please note that a single storefront page can be tied only to one ad. You can determine whether a storefront page has already been tied to an ad by the value of the `is_associated` field in the reponse of the `/page/get/` endpoint. ``` xcodeblock (code Bash json) curl --location --request GET 'https://ads.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/get/?advertiser_id=123&business_type=STORE_FRONT' \ --header 'Access-Token: YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN' (/code) ``` # 3. Create a collection ad ## 3.1 Create a campaign Use the [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602) endpoint to create a campaign. The `objective_type` can be set to `TRAFFIC`, `CONVERSION`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `REACH`. Here is an example of the data in the request. ``` xcodeblock (code JSON json) { "advertiser_id": 123, "campaign_name": "my-collection-ads-campaign", "objective_type": "TRAFFIC", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_INFINITE" } (/code) ``` ## 3.2 Create an ad group Use the [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114) endpoint to create an ad group. Field settings: - Set `promotion_type` to `WEBSITE`. - Set `placements` to `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Here is an example of the data in the request. ``` xcodeblock (code JSON json) { "advertiser_id": 123, "campaign_id": 456, "optimization_goal": "CLICK", "adgroup_name": "test-wjm-collection_ads", "location": [ 1668284 ], "promotion_type": "WEBSITE", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_DAY", "billing_event": "CPC", "bid": 1, "placement_type": "PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL", "placements": [ "PLACEMENT_TIKTOK" ], "schedule_start_time": "2021-03-15 00:00:00", "schedule_end_time": "2021-03-16 00:00:00", "schedule_type": "SCHEDULE_START_END", "budget": 50, "pacing": "PACING_MODE_SMOOTH", "bid_type": "BID_TYPE_CUSTOM" } (/code) ``` ## 3.3 Create an ad Use the [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354) endpoint to create an ad. Field settings: - You must specify the `page_id`, which has been obtained in step 2.2. - Set `ad_format` to `SINGLE_VIDEO`. - You do not need to specify the page URL or CTA, as they are already included in the `page_id`. ``` xcodeblock (code JSON json) { "advertiser_id": 123, "adgroup_id": 456, "creatives": [ { "ad_format": "SINGLE_VIDEO", "image_ids": ["your_image_id"], "video_id": "your_video_id", "ad_text": "your ad text", "ad_name": "your_ad_name", "display_name": "your display name", "page_id": 789 } ] } (/code) ```
